recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍下，在混合的造血細胞中散在許多細胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒的細胞，部分呈梭形或不規則，符合增加的肥大細胞；需在高倍確認核形並以 CD25/CD2 及 KIT D816V 支持系統性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Mixed hematopoietic cells in a particle-poor aspirate with fat spaces
Scattered cells with dense dark purple cytoplasmic granules consistent with mast cells
Some granulated cells spindled or irregular in outline
Admixed erythroid precursors, granulocytes and lymphocytes
Low magnification limits detailed nuclear assessment
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification shows mixed trilineage hematopoietic cells with numerous scattered cells containing coarse dark purple metachromatic granules, several with spindled or irregular contours, consistent with increased mast cells. Nuclear detail is limited at this power. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; atypical morphology in more than 25 percent of mast cells, CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V testing support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Basophilia in CML or other MPN
ddx.vs: Basophils have lobated nuclei obscured by granules and are smaller and round, not spindled.
Reactive mast cells are round, well granulated and scattered, lacking spindled morphology and CD25 expression.
Eosinophils have bilobed nuclei and orange-red refractile granules rather than purple metachromatic granules.
